mapper.select: SELECT a.biz02_person_id AS person_id , a.biz02_promo_id AS promo_id , a.biz02_emp_yn = 'true' AS emp_yn , a.biz02_emp_id AS emp_id , f_emp_kor_nm(a.biz02_emp_id) AS emp_name , f_org_nm(c.emp03_org_code_id, b.biz01_provide_date) AS org_name , NULL::varchar AS target_company_name , NULL::varchar AS target_emp_name , NULL::varchar AS target_org_name FROM biz02_person a LEFT OUTER JOIN biz01_promo b ON a.biz02_promo_id = b.biz01_promo_id LEFT OUTER JOIN emp03_trans c ON (a.biz02_emp_id = c.emp03_person_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp04_add_title WHERE emp04_add_person_id = a.biz02_emp_id AND ( emp04_start_date > b.biz01_provide_date OR COALESCE(emp04_close_date,'9999-12-31') < b.biz01_provide_date ) ) AND emp03_trans_date = (SELECT max(x.emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans x WHERE x.emp03_person_id = biz02_emp_id AND x.emp03_trans_date <= b.biz01_provide_date)) WHERE 1=1 AND b.biz01_company_id = #{companyId} AND biz02_promo_id = #{promoId} AND biz02_emp_yn = 'true'

SELECT a.biz02_person_id AS person_id , a.biz02_promo_id AS promo_id , a.biz02_emp_yn = 'true' AS emp_yn , a.biz02_emp_id AS emp_id , NULL::varchar AS emp_name , NULL::varchar AS org_name , a.biz02_target_company_nm AS target_company_name , a.biz02_target_emp_nm AS target_emp_name , a.biz02_target_org_nm AS target_org_name FROM biz02_person a INNER JOIN biz01_promo b ON a.biz02_promo_id = b.biz01_promo_id WHERE 1=1 AND b.biz01_company_id = #{companyId} AND biz02_promo_id = #{promoId} AND biz02_emp_yn = 'false'
